input.quote: 26. APPLICABLE LAW. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law).
input.rationale: Sections 26 and 27 supply California governing law and an exclusive California court forum (state or federal courts in San Luis Obispo County), with no arbitration clause anywhere in the Agreement. That sits squarely at our fallback position (Delaware or California law and the corresponding California courts) rather than the preferred New York law / New York County courts, so it is acceptable and we do not redline it. Noted only in passing: the venue is TrueLink's home county, but both parties are California-domiciled (Client in Irvine) and California is on our accepted list, so this is not walk-away territory; the clause also lacks a preferred-level carve-out for temporary injunctive relief elsewhere, which is a minor sub-element short of preferred wording.

mappings.element: The governing law is Delaware, California, or England and Wales.
